submitted.rationale: XRD shows the rutile/trirutile (CoSb2O6-type) phase gets stronger from Sb about 0.5 up to the Sb-rich end. The EQE measurements rise steeply with Sb fraction: index 10 gave 0.00019%, index 20 gave 0.0063% and index 23 (Sb 0.77) gave 0.034%. Index 23 is the best measured composition.

rejected.reason: Co-rich and mostly poorly crystalline or mixed phase; EQE 0.00019%, about 180 times lower than index 23
Close to stoichiometric CoSb2O6, but EQE 0.0063% is about 5 times lower than index 23
Not measured for EQE. XRD at index 4 shows no strong trirutile peaks, and EQE falls toward the Co-rich end
